written_before: any Round 7 training step, any Round 7 closed-loop episode, and the fresh-slice draw
plan: design/R7_CAMPAIGN.md (panel design, 2026-11-04 evening); this file is section 3 of that plan as pre-registered
question: Does an explicit sensors-only belief (plate / lamp / mat bearing, distance, age) make the 10 Hz command policy act on what it sees (turn toward and walk to a seen or remembered plate, verify, then say done), measured on the press-needed set-lamp rooms?

bar.rooms: the 80 confirmation rooms: instances-dev 0030-0049, arrangements/appearances/distractor-dev 0020-0039, set_lamp, k=0 (second project look; paired with the step-5 rows, never a headline)
bar.press_needed_successes: >= 2 per seed and >= 5 over two seeds (40 press-needed rooms)
bar.said_done_without_press_pn: not above the arm's own base recipe on the same rooms: Hr 27 (s0) / 28 (s1) of 40, R3 22 / 20 of 40 (results/p2/confirm.jsonl)
bar.stage_counts: per seed and per family: reached plate, within 0.5 m, pressed, lamp right at end, said done, said done after press (lamp right / wrong); never averaged over appearances-dev (the bot drops to 4/10 there)
bar.headline: a fresh reserved slice (splits/r7_*.json, 20 rooms per family, slots 9-12, dev-family rules), drawn in Stage 0 before any training and looked at once in Stage 5 after the method set freezes; the absolute bar (2 per seed, 5 over two seeds against 40 press-needed rooms) is kept if the draw yields 32-48 press-needed set-lamp rooms, otherwise extra rooms are drawn in Stage 0 until it does

intentionality_metric.why: the bar is gameable: a scripted done after a lamp-right press would give Hr 6/80 on rooms already looked at (section 1 of the plan); every bar count is reported beside these
intentionality_metric.instrument: evaluation-side sensors-only tracker on the learner's own frames (odometry.py leg mode with anchors off, bodymodel camera pose, perception.detect, refbot.Memory incl. lamp_update); truth only to score
intentionality_metric.intentional_reach: body-centre plate entry within K ticks of the tracker's first confirmed lamp sighting, with odometry path length / straight line over that stretch <= R; K and R calibrated in Stage 0 so the frozen bot passes on >= 90% of its own press-needed successes (plan defaults K=400, R=2.5); calibrated values appended below before any training
intentionality_metric.turn_onset: the first turn run (>= 6 ticks of |wz| > 0.1 while standing) after the lamp check starts toward the shorter bearing to the remembered plate (tracker button track, replayed odometry)
intentionality_metric.verified_done: a done after a press counts as verified only if the tracker confirms a fresh lamp sighting between the press and the done
intentionality_metric.learned_claim: intentional reaches >= half of reaches and verified dones >= half of done-after-press, per seed; successes that fail these still count for the bar and are reported as 'unverified'

turn_onset_probe.protocol: 27 p2_dev press-needed demos with a blind first turn after the lamp check (scratch/r7/critic_dreamzero/blind_turn_t0.py), teacher-forced, MLX inference
turn_onset_probe.baseline: share p(bot dir) > p(opp) at t0 0.48-0.74; argmax = bot direction 2-5 of 27

bearing_read.baseline: ridge readout of R3 s1's GRU state: median 57-72 deg at the lamp check, 17-27% within 30 deg; out of view 53-65 deg
bearing_read.gate: median error at the lamp check <= 30 deg and >= 60% of checks within 30 deg; out of view <= 30 deg

closed_loop_stage_gate.rooms: the 40 selection rooms (instances/arrangements/appearances/distractor-dev 0000-0009, k=0): 18 press-needed, 22 no-press; also the checkpoint-pick rooms (p2_select rule unchanged)

per_seed.said_done_without_press: <= the base recipe's pick on the same rooms: Hr s1 12/18, R3 s1 6/18

closed_loop_stage_gate.caveat: 30 of the 40 selection rooms also hold p2_dev demos; the rooms have been used for 17+ picks

seeds_and_power: two seeds per arm, never promote on one; with p = 0.025 per episode P(>= 2 of 40) = 0.26 per seed and P(>= 5 of 80) = 0.05, with p = 0.10 0.92 and 0.90; differences of 1-2 episodes are noise
controls: shuffled-input control for any supplied-input arm (vector values from a random other episode's tick); the pixel-free policy for the map-sensor arm; shuffled-label and (skill, lamp-belief)-conditioned most-frequent-next-skill for the selector; the frozen bot as the ceiling
disclosure: Stages 1B, 2 and 3 run the bot's own sensors-only modules at test time; every table labels them 'learned decisions + supplied perception/skills'; no simulator truth enters any controller
arms: 1C belief heads on R3 (1 seed) and onset weighting on R3 (1 seed): open-loop probes only
1D map-free pixel servo (oracle latch / lamp-perception latch): baseline rows, not learned
2A Hr + belief vector (2 seeds) + shuffled-vector control (2 seeds)
4D Astra weight-space edits over named inputs (after a 2A reach gate)
5 fresh slice: step-5 Hr s0/s1 + R3 s1, bot, every passed arm
not_run_by_owner_decision: teacher activity strings as an aux target

kill_rules.1A: plate-bearing label p90 > 45 deg on approaches: fix the replay or require bot_pose recordings before any belief arm
kill_rules.1B: both seeds fail the reach gate (< 6/18): Stage 2 is cut, Stage 3 is the main arm
kill_rules.2A: both seeds fail the reach gate: the pixel policy cannot use the map; if the pixel-free policy ties or beats 2A, the pixels add nothing
kill_rules.2B: no gain over the +4k-old-data control in both seeds
kill_rules.3A: learned selector within 2 episodes of the belief-conditioned control: scaffolding; 3B becomes a one-seed documentation run
kill_rules.3B: within 2 episodes of the belief-conditioned control on both seeds: scaffolding, not learning
kill_rules.1D: reached plate < 6/18 with the oracle latch kills the 'compile a stage machine into weights' route

lane_plan: <= 2 concurrent jobs counted by PID, <= 45 min per invocation with verified resume, <= 16 GB per process, OMP_NUM_THREADS=4 for training and 1 x 4 processes for evaluations

amendments.finding: The 20-per-family draw (80 rooms) yields 29 press-needed set-lamp rooms (k=0), below the pre-registered 32-48 (make_splits.py --r7 deterministic draw; counts for 21..30 per family: 31, 33, 36, 40, 42, 45, 46, 48, 50, 53).
amendments.change: The slice is 24 rooms per family (96 rooms; the first 20 per family are the original draw, unchanged): 40 press-needed rooms, the same count as the 80 confirmation rooms, so the absolute bar (>= 2 per seed, >= 5 over two seeds) applies unchanged. The smallest in-range extension (22 per family, 33 press-needed) was not chosen so that the bar needs no re-scaling. No room of the slice has been run.

amendments.written_before: any Stage 1B closed-loop gate reading (the 1B-v0 selections were in progress; their partial rows had been seen for checkpoints 4k-12k) and before any Stage 2/3 run
amendments.finding: While debugging the Stage 3 adapter, the belief vector's lamp one-hot was found to follow the bot's Memory.lamp_state(), which demands a fresh run of >= 3 consecutive sightings and so flickers back to 'unknown' after an isolated re-sighting (e.g. instances-dev-0000: known at tick 100, unknown at 103-262). In the vector that is the only slot carrying the lamp state (the merged lamp track carries position only), so the policy's lamp belief was intermittently blank in training and at deployment.
amendments.change: belief.py VERSION r7_belief_v2: the lamp one-hot and its age come from the latest confirmed lamp track (lamp_on / lamp_off, n >= confirm), i.e. sticky; everything else unchanged. Side files rebuilt, the 1A gate re-run on v2, tests updated. Stage 1B is re-run as 1B-v1 (same recipe, seeds 0 and 1, same gates); the 1B-v0 rows are kept and reported as a superseded attempt in the ledger, not as the stage result. The Stage 3 adapter's explore step now mirrors the bot's find()/lamp-search step (scan pitch, stop when the sought object is confirmed).

amendments.written_after: the method freeze (00:24) and 11 of 15 fresh-slice arms; a deviation, disclosed
amendments.finding: The Stage 3 adapter (p2_skillsel.SelectorBot.run) could loop without consuming a tick: look_lamp returns at once when no lamp is remembered, and a chooser that repeats that choice (features unchanged) never advances the clock. The shuffled-label control, seed 1, hit this on the fresh slice (57 min, four workers spinning); every other arm had completed. The learned / program / belief-conditioned arms cannot enter the loop in practice (the program picks look_lamp only after a press, by which point the lamp is remembered), and a loop that exits is impossible (same features -> same choice), so no completed result is affected.
amendments.change: A guard: the third consecutive zero-tick decision costs one stop tick (regression test tests/test_r7_skillsel.py::test_adapter_never_hangs_on_a_zero_tick_choice). The hung job was killed (parent + workers, exact PIDs); the shuffled-s1 fresh run restarts from scratch with the guard, followed by the three arms that had not started (freq, program, 3B). No pick, threshold or arm definition changes.
